mootLines.line: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Fully identify 3 plants (knowledge level 3) within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.

◈ FLASHBACK — Lucky Coin
Worn smooth. Larry flipped it before every hard thing and said: heads or tails, it always lands on keep going. You have stopped checking which side lands.
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
It's Valentina who says it first. "Raising hands against one of us — don't look away, any of you." Heads turn. 3 days until the moot. Use them.
📓 Codex: Accused of assault by Valentina. Moot in 3 days.
◈ THE TRIAL — the audience is restless. The System offers Joseph a trial, broadcast live. Survive it and take the slot. Refuse it and... well. The audience remembers refusals. (Ability slots: 4)
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "A trial, broadcast live. The audience loves a trial." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
Valentina calls the moot. The fire gets built up — word travels fast, and almost everyone comes.
The oldest among them stands. The fire seems to lean in. "You — take what you can carry and go."
◈ CRISIS — THE SCHISM. You are cast out. The village chose, and the choosing cut something that won’t heal clean. The fire keeps burning without you.
Exiled. You leave with what you carry — nothing more. Behind you, Haven keeps its fire. Ahead: the world, which just got much bigger.
📓 Codex: Exiled (moot). Walking.
The pantry is closed to you. The book stays behind. To Haven, you are not one of ours anymore. Membership asked nothing — no presence, no check-ins. Exile is the one way to lose it.
The pantry is not yours anymore. Exile means exile — membership had no check-ins, but it had exactly one way to lose it.
Reason: defied exile. You did this.
You walk the old paths to the fire. Nobody meets your eyes. The pantry is closed to you — exile means exile. What you carry is still yours to give, if you want to start earning your way back.
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
The old paths, the same fire, the same averted eyes. Still exile. The way back hasn't changed: carry something worth having.
"The moot spoke, and I was standing right there." Liam's voice stays level; keeping it level is clearly costing them. "I don't get to un-speak it over small talk. Go on, now."
